scope: Reuse one token vector and one successful parse in CLI source discovery. Isolated source selection and timing only; no whole build or Stage acceptance.
decisions: CSharp ParseSourceFile reads and decodes a source once, lexes once, and passes the tokens to Parser.Parse. LoadUserPrograms keys explicit files by normalized path and retains parsed roots for source selection.

SLG cliSources.readSource reads the same mapped file through parser.parseSourceEvents (one lex+parse), lexer.lexSource (second lex) and ast.lowerSource (third lex and second parse before lowering). All use the same full source view, grammar.startRule and lexer.lexText.

One token vector followed by parsePreparedRuleEvents and ast.lowerPreparedRule can reuse the exact existing engines. Preserve the events success gate, AST node/token source coordinates, library validation order, entry/source/import routing and all diagnostics. Do not add a separate header parser or change grammar.

The current build process dispatched windows-stdlib-cache after about 49.4 seconds according to process creation timestamps. This is all pre-dispatch work, not a measurement of readSource alone. No speedup or throughput is claimed.
